title: One-Pot Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Comforting noodles cooked in one pot and finished with butter and parmesan.
substitutions: Use any long pasta; cooking time may vary.
A handful of frozen peas can go in for the last 3 minutes.

steps.text: Boil pasta in broth/water until tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Stir in butter, garlic, parmesan, and pepper.

cookSteps.text: Put {{pasta}} pasta, {{broth}} broth or water, salt, and garlic powder into a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then cook uncovered, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and only a little starchy liquid remains, about 10–12 minutes.
Turn the heat low. Stir in {{butter}} butter, {{parm}} parmesan, and black pepper until glossy and creamy.
Serve immediately.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat with a splash of water or milk.

title: Small-Batch Apple Crisp
description: A two-to-three serving apple crisp with a buttery oat topping.

steps.text: Toss apples with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Rub topping together and sprinkle over apples.

cookSteps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Butter a small baking dish.
Toss {{apples}} sliced apples with {{brown}} brown sugar and cinnamon. Put them in the dish.
Mix oats, flour, granulated sugar, salt, and {{butter}} softened butter with your fingers until crumbly.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the apples.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until the apples are bubbling and the top is golden.
Let it rest 5 minutes before serving so the filling settles slightly.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat briefly in the oven or microwave.

title: Crockpot Salsa Chicken
description: Two-ingredient-style shredded chicken for wraps, rice bowls, or baked potatoes.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

substitutions: Use thighs for a more forgiving texture.

steps.text: Put chicken and salsa in slow cooker.
Cook LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.

cookSteps.text: Put {{chicken}} chicken in the slow cooker. Sprinkle with salt and cumin if using.
Pour {{salsa}} salsa over the chicken.
Cover and cook on HIGH about 3–4 hours, until the chicken is fully cooked and pulls apart easily.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the cooker, then stir it into the salsa and juices.
Serve in tortillas, over rice, or on baked potatoes.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Quick Lentil Pasta Marinara
description: Protein-rich lentil pasta with jarred marinara for a fast meatless dinner.
substitutions: Regular pasta works if that is what you have.

steps.text: Boil lentil pasta according to package timing.

cookSteps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook {{pasta}} lentil pasta according to the package directions. Start checking it at the earliest time listed so it does not get mushy.
While the pasta cooks, warm {{sauce}} marinara sauce in a small pan or microwave-safe bowl.
Drain the pasta and stir in the warm sauce.
Add parmesan and Italian seasoning if using, then serve.
